data-migration.description: Migrates, backfills or deletes persisted data

public-contract.description: Breaks or changes something consumed outside this repo (a published package API, an HTTP API, an event or a file format others read): removes or renames it, or changes behaviour its consumers rely on. A backwards-compatible addition, such as a new optional prop or a new export, is no Risk flag

infrastructure.description: Changes infrastructure, CI or production configuration
